title: Knowledge team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/knowledge.yaml, the team layer of the knowledge plugin's settings. Keys and resolution: plugins/knowledge/reference/config.md.

upstream_records_dir.description: Repository-relative directory where /knowledge:absorb-upstream writes its upstream record. Not absolute, no leading ~, no .. segment.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example video-digest); an entry beats this file's verification value.
